summary: Registration form — pre-fill Aircraft Type from selected flight plan context
description: When a user opens a new registration form from a flight plan context, the Aircraft Type field must be pre-filled with the aircraft type recorded in the selected flight plan. The pre-filled value must be a valid entry in the dropdown loaded from the API.

acs.text: Aircraft Type field is pre-filled with the value from the flight plan when the form is opened in flight-plan context
The pre-filled value appears as the selected option in the loaded dropdown

If the flight plan's aircraft type is no longer present in the active types list, the field shows an inline validation warning: 'Aircraft type from flight plan is no longer available — please select a valid type'

out_of_scope: Pre-filling any field other than Aircraft Type from flight plan context
